review_scope_note: Unlike prior API-based reviews that saw only the finding text, this audit had full repository access: experiment kernels, archived run logs/CSVs, prior reviews, remediations, and paper/CERTIFICATE.md where applicable. Quantitative claims were checked against primary artifacts; arithmetic and hashes were recomputed where feasible. No computational result was invented.
verification_methods: Parsed all 1,048,575 rows of spectrum_n20.csv (brace-aware) and looked up key subsets
Recomputed Spearman/Kendall on n=10 subsets with dim>0
Checked body removal-cost table against CSV

claim_reviews.evidence: CSV: 0.836829443681209, 0.768313628447352, 0.965393263525216. The 0.768 correction (was 0.826) is real and strengthens the finding.

claim_reviews.claim: Removing digit 1 from {1..20} costs ~0.197; removing 20 costs ~0.002 (~100:1).
Body table of dimensions after removing digits 2/3/4/5/10 from {1..15}: 0.907/0.932/0.941/0.945/0.951.
claim_reviews.evidence: Actual CSV values: 0.856353 / 0.897003 / 0.916614 / 0.927435 / 0.944914. Headline numbers are right; this mid-table is wrong.

claim_reviews.claim: All 2^20-1 subsets computed; Spearman ρ≈0.951, Kendall τ≈0.834 vs Σ1/a² on 1013 positive subsets of {1..10}.

claim_reviews.evidence: run_n20.log ≈4342.8s; metadata_n20.json / recompute log report 8654.9s for a second run with agreeing dimensions. Say which run is canonical.

claim_reviews.claim: N=40 Chebyshev / ~15 digits / truncation ~1e-12 without N-convergence study.
claim_reviews.evidence: Parameters match metadata; error bars are not demonstrated. Differences ≲0.003 are already hedged in the summary — good.

missing_references: N-convergence study; Jenkinson–Pollicott / Hensley references for validation anchors
overall_assessment: A beautiful computational geometry-of-numbers observation: five digits containing 1 beat fourteen without it, and the 0.768 correction was the right scientific move. Correlations reproduce. The erroneous mid-table removal costs must be fixed; precision claims need a convergence study. Silver remains appropriate for the headline result.
recommendations: Replace the removal-cost mid-table with CSV values
Add N-convergence appendix before claiming 15-digit precision uniformly
certification_justification: Complete novel spectrum with validated anchors (Zaremba δ, Jenkinson–Pollicott E_{1,2}) and reproducible headline inequalities. Mid-table errors are fixable without touching the core claim.
